# Two splits: one on an equity account, the other on a liability account.
# `Equity:Owner Contributions USD` +100.00 against `Liabilities:Credit Card
# USD` −100.00.
#
# The company drew 100.00 on the card and booked it against the owner's
# capital. Nothing here is a cost.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, neither split in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: Equity
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Owner Contributions USD
	type: Equity
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Credit Card USD
	type: Credit Card
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-03-20 * "Capital drawn on the card"
	guid: "5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Equity:Owner Contributions USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Credit Card USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
